about.description: LRCX is a single-stock perpetual listed on Gate, tracking Lam Research Corp., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Gate prices this market off the Backed xStock token for Lam Research Corp., a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
